title: Imagine the Future, Internalize the Gist: Efficient VLA Reasoning via Internalized Spatiotemporal Imagination
title_zh: 构想未来，内化核心：通过内化的时空想象实现高效的VLA推理

paragraphs.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate intermediate reasoning to improve robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches primarily reason about observed states without explicitly anticipating future scene evolution. Extending such reasoning to explicit future rollouts at every inference step, however, introduces substantial computational overhead. We propose IG-VLA , a VLA reasoning framework that enables models to i magine the future and internalize the g ist . Our Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning learns to imagine task-relevant future scene evolution directly in visual representation space, guiding action prediction without costly pixel-level video generation. To further reduce inference overhead, we introduce Scene Gist Memory , which internalizes reasoning-derived scene–behavior associations into a compact Scene Gist Token, preserving the benefits of future reasoning while bypassing explicit future imagination at inference. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of IG-VLA. On the LIBERO-Plus Language suite, both the reasoning and gist policies outperform the strongest baseline by nearly 6% in success rate. The gist policy also achieves up to 6.38 × 6.38\times speedup over baselines, reducing inference latency from 1,081 ms to 169.5 ms per action chunk on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU. These results demonstrate that future spatiotemporal reasoning can be effectively internalized for efficient VLA deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型正越来越多地引入中间推理环节以提升机器人操作能力，但现有方法主要对观测到的状态进行推理，而未明确预测未来场景的演变。 然而，若要在每次推理步骤中都将此类推理扩展至明确的未来推演，则会带来巨大的计算开销。 我们提出了 IG-VLA——一种 VLA 推理框架，使模型能够想象未来并内化场景要点。 我们的潜在时空推理模块能够在视觉表示空间中直接学习任务相关的未来场景演变，从而指导动作预测，而无需耗费大量资源进行像素级的视频生成。 为进一步降低推理开销，我们引入了场景要点记忆机制，它将推理过程中形成的场景-行为关联内化为一个紧凑的场景要点令牌，既保留了未来推理的优势，又避免了推理阶段对未来的显式想象。 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 VLABench 上开展的广泛实验证明了 IG-VLA 的有效性和高效性。 在 LIBERO-Plus 语言任务套件中，推理策略和场景要点策略的成功率均比最强基线模型高出近 6%。 场景要点策略的速度也比基线模型提升了高达 6.38 倍，在单块 NVIDIA A6000 GPU 上，每个动作分片的推理延迟从 1,081 毫秒降至 169.5 毫秒。 这些结果表明，未来时空推理可以被有效内化，从而实现高效的 VLA 部署。

paragraphs.en: In general, existing approaches face two limitations: (i) reliance on observed states rather than future predictions, and (ii) substantial computational overhead from repeated reasoning rollouts. Specifically, existing approaches primarily reason over observed states and plan subsequent actions based on the current environment, without explicitly anticipating how the environment may evolve under different decisions. Meanwhile, reasoning in VLA models need to perform full spatiotemporal reasoning rollouts repeatedly at every inference step, introducing substantial computation overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，现有方法面临两个局限性：(i) 依赖观测到的状态而非未来预测，以及 (ii) 重复推理展开带来的巨大计算开销。 具体而言，现有方法主要基于观测到的状态进行推理，并根据当前环境规划后续动作，而未明确预测环境在不同决策下可能如何演变。 同时，VLA 模型中的推理需要在每次推理步骤中反复执行完整的时间空间推理展开，从而产生巨大的计算开销。

paragraphs.en: To address these issues, we propose a visual reasoning framework for VLA models with two core mechanisms: latent spatiotemporal reasoning and scene gist memory . Latent spatiotemporal reasoning enables the model to imagine future scene evolution in visual representation space, exploring plausible action trajectories and their potential outcomes. These imagined futures guide action selection, as shown in Figure 1 (b). It is inspired by human reasoning process, which imagines how a scene might unfold under different candidate actions and makes decisions based on expected consequences Atance and O’Neill (2001) . For example, when crossing a street, we consider multiple possible futures conditioned on our own actions such as crossing, waiting, or speeding up, then choose the safest action. This anticipation evaluates candidate behaviors through the imagined consequences rather than merely extrapolating scene evolution independently of actions Conti and Irish (2021) .
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种面向 VLA 模型的视觉推理框架，包含两种核心机制：潜在时空推理和场景主旨记忆。 潜在时空推理使模型能够在视觉表示空间中想象未来场景的演变过程，探索可行的行动轨迹及其潜在结果。 这些被想象的未来会指导行动选择，如圖 1 (b) 所示。 该机制受人类推理过程的启发：人类会设想场景在不同候选行动下的可能发展，并基于预期后果做出决策 Atance and O’Neill (2001)。 例如，在过马路时，我们会根据自身的行动（如过马路、等待或加速）考虑多种可能的未来情景，然后选择最安全的行动。 这种预测机制通过想象行动可能带来的后果来评估候选行为，而非仅仅独立于行动地外推场景演变 Conti and Irish (2021)。

paragraphs.en: To reduce computational overhead, our proposed Scene Gist Memory internalizes reasoning-derived scene–behavior associations into a compact Scene Gist Token . This token captures general scene context and corresponding action patterns rather than preserving the complete future reasoning trajectory. During inference, the gist encoder predicts the Scene Gist directly from the current context, allowing the model to bypass the explicit future-reasoning pathway while retaining reasoning-derived behavioral guidance (Figure 2 ). It’s inspired by human behavioral psychology that repeated experience in familiar environments helps consolidate learned behaviors into procedural memory involving the basal ganglia Wulf et al. (2010) ; Wood and Rünger (2016) . This memory supports rapid responses with less deliberation, reducing cognitive effort and decision time. For example, familiarity with a home allows a person to head directly to the kitchen for coffee without searching the entire house. Repeated experience reinforces the association between the familiar scene and the corresponding navigation behavior. Our main contributions are summarized as follows:

paragraphs.en: Implementation Details. We use 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs to train the reasoning module and use 4 NVIDIA A6000 GPUs to train the gist memeory module, while we only use a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU for end-to-end inference latency evaluation. We build on the PaliGemma-based backbone Zhong et al. (2026) , using SigLIP So400m/14 as the vision encoder, Gemma-2B as the multimodal prefix model, and Gemma-300M modules as action experts. Latent spatiotemporal reasoning module predicts K = 10 K=10 future SigLIP latent states, supervised by latent MSE and cosine direction losses, while the auxiliary pixel reconstruction head is used only during training. For LIBERO, we train for 100K steps with a batch size of 16 and a peak learning rate of 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} (cosine decay to 1 × 10 − 7 1\times 10^{-7} ). For VLABench, we follow the configuration of Zhong et al. (2026) with 61K training steps and a batch size of 128 to ensure a controlled comparison.

paragraphs.en: Main Results. Tables 1 – 3 present the simulation results on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench. On LIBERO, both IG-VLA (Reasoning Policy) and IG-VLA △ (Gist Policy) achieve the highest average success rate of 98.9%, outperforming the strongest baseline ACoT-VLA of 98.5%. In particular, IG-VLA △ achieves 100.0% and 97.8% success rates on the Object and Long suites, respectively, demonstrating that Scene Gist preserves strong manipulation performance without explicit future reasoning rollout. On LIBERO-Plus, our supervised fine-tuning achieves the best average success rate of 88.5%, exceeding best baseline ACoT-VLA by 0.5 percentage points, with a notable improvement on language variation from 79.7% to 85.6%. Consistent improvements are also observed on VLABench, where our method achieves the highest average Intention Score (IS) of 66.68, improving over ACoT-VLA by 3.18 points. The improvement is particularly pronounced under semantic-instruction variation, where IS and PS increase from 56.8/39.6 to 65.2/48.49, respectively. Although the average PS on VLABench is slightly lower than ACoT-VLA (46.11 vs. 47.40), the overall results across the three benchmarks demonstrate that latent spatiotemporal reasoning improves intention understanding and action prediction, while Scene Gist effectively internalizes these reasoning benefits for efficient manipulation without explicit future rollout.

paragraphs.en: End-to-end Inference Speedup. Table 5 compares the end-to-end inference latency of our method with existing baselines on LIBERO using a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU. We report latency per action chunk to characterize the computational cost of generating each action sequence. With Scene Gist Memory, IG-VLA △ requires only 169.5 ms per action chunk, achieving 1.78 × 1.78\times and 1.55 × 1.55\times speedups over FastWAM (1-step) (302 ms) and ImageWAM (263 ms), respectively. Alongside this inference efficiency, the gist policy achieves a 98.9% average success rate on LIBERO, surpassing ImageWAM (98.4%) and the strongest baseline, ACoT-VLA (98.5%). These results indicate that the lower inference cost is accompanied by strong manipulation performance. By internalizing reasoning-derived scene–behavior associations into a compact Scene Gist Token, the gist policy guides action prediction without repeatedly performing explicit future rollouts. This allows IG-VLA △ to retain the benefits of future reasoning while reducing its inference overhead, supporting efficient VLA deployment. Baseline results are taken from the ImageWAM paper ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Latency Breakdown Analysis. Figure 4 further analyzes the computational cost of our reasoning and gist policies. Explicit spatiotemporal reasoning incurs 256.9 ms of GPU time, whereas the Scene Gist predictor introduces only 0.13 ms of additional overhead. Consequently, replacing explicit future reasoning with Scene Gist reduces the overall GPU time from 420.7 ms to 169.5 ms. Importantly, this substantial efficiency gain does not compromise task performance: our gist policy achieves the highest average success rate of 98.9% on LIBERO, outperforming the strongest baseline ACoT-VLA (98.5%) by 0.4 percentage points.
paragraphs.zh: 延迟分解分析。 图 4 进一步分析了我们的推理和场景摘要策略的计算成本。 显式时空推理需要 256.9 毫秒的 GPU 时间，而场景摘要预测器仅带来 0.13 毫秒的额外开销。 因此，用场景摘要替换显式的未来推理，可将总体 GPU 时间从 420.7 毫秒减少到 169.5 毫秒。 重要的是，这种显著的效率提升并未损害任务性能：我们的场景摘要策略在 LIBERO 上实现了 98.9% 的最高平均成功率，比最强的基线模型 ACoT-VLA（98.5%）高出 0.4 个百分点。

Increasing K K from 3 to 10 consistently improves the average success rate from 98.10% to 98.90%, suggesting that a sufficient imagination horizon provides richer future dynamics for action reasoning. We study the relative weighting between the two training objectives by fixing λ reg = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{reg}}=1 and varying λ dir \lambda_{\mathrm{dir}} , thereby controlling the contribution of directional consistency relative to latent transition regression. As shown in Figure 6 , λ dir = 0.1 \lambda_{\mathrm{dir}}=0.1 (main results default setting) achieves the best success rate of 99.4% on LIBERO-Spatial. Increasing λ dir \lambda_{\mathrm{dir}} to 0.3 slightly reduces the success rate to 98.6%, while larger weights of 0.5 and 0.8 lead to substantial degradation to 37.0% and 25.7%, respectively. This suggests that the directional objective is most effective as a lightweight auxiliary constraint. A moderate weight encourages alignment with the future visual transition, whereas an overly large weight overemphasizes directional consistency relative to transition-magnitude regression and destabilizes the learning objective. paragraphs.en: Effects of Different Number of MLP Layers for Training Gist Policy. We ablate the number of MLP layers in the Gist Policy to study the trade-off between model capacity and training efficiency. As shown in Figure 6 , increasing the depth from one to two layers improves the average LIBERO success rate from 97.8% to 98.9%, indicating that a single layer provides insufficient capacity to effectively capture the reasoning-derived Scene Gist. Further increasing the depth to three layers provides no additional benefit, slightly decreasing the success rate to 98.8% while increasing the training cost from 3.45 to 5.79 GPU hours. We therefore adopt a two-layer MLP for the Gist Policy, which provides sufficient capacity while avoiding unnecessary training overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 不同数量的MLP层对Gist策略训练的影响。 我们通过调整Gist策略中MLP层的数量，研究模型容量与训练效率之间的权衡关系。 如图6所示，将深度从一层增加到两层，使LIBERO的平均成功率从97.8%提升至98.9%，表明单层结构不足以有效捕捉推理生成的场景要点。 进一步将深度增至三层并未带来额外收益，反而使成功率轻微下降至98.8%，同时训练成本从3.45 GPU小时增至5.79 GPU小时。 因此，我们为Gist策略采用两层MLP结构，既能提供足够的模型容量，又能避免不必要的训练开销。

sents.en: Effects of Different Number of MLP Layers for Training Gist Policy.
sents.zh: 不同数量的MLP层对Gist策略训练的影响。

sents.en: We ablate the number of MLP layers in the Gist Policy to study the trade-off between model capacity and training efficiency.
sents.zh: 我们通过调整Gist策略中MLP层的数量，研究模型容量与训练效率之间的权衡关系。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 6 , increasing the depth from one to two layers improves the average LIBERO success rate from 97.8% to 98.9%, indicating that a single layer provides insufficient capacity to effectively capture the reasoning-derived Scene Gist.
sents.zh: 如图6所示，将深度从一层增加到两层，使LIBERO的平均成功率从97.8%提升至98.9%，表明单层结构不足以有效捕捉推理生成的场景要点。

sents.en: Further increasing the depth to three layers provides no additional benefit, slightly decreasing the success rate to 98.8% while increasing the training cost from 3.45 to 5.79 GPU hours.
sents.zh: 进一步将深度增至三层并未带来额外收益，反而使成功率轻微下降至98.8%，同时训练成本从3.45 GPU小时增至5.79 GPU小时。

sents.en: We therefore adopt a two-layer MLP for the Gist Policy, which provides sufficient capacity while avoiding unnecessary training overhead.
sents.zh: 因此，我们为Gist策略采用两层MLP结构，既能提供足够的模型容量，又能避免不必要的训练开销。

paragraphs.en: Real-World Evaluation. We further deploy the fine-tuned policy on a dual-arm UR3 robotic platform equipped with parallel-jaw grippers and three RGB cameras, as shown in Figure 7 (a). We consider a pick-and-place task in which the robot grasps a screwdriver and places it at a target location, and fine-tune all policies on 77 teleoperated demonstrations. Under identical deployment and fine-tuning settings, we compare our method with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and ACoT-VLA, conducting 16 trials for each policy with randomized initial screwdriver placements. As shown in Figure 7 (b), our method achieves the highest success rate of 62.5%, compared with 56.2% for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 50.0% for ACoT-VLA. These results further demonstrate that incorporating future spatiotemporal reasoning improves manipulation performance beyond the underlying VLA backbone and prior action-reasoning approaches. Detailed deployment settings and action-space conversion are provided in Appendix A.2 .

paragraphs.en: In this work, we present IG-VLA to address two key limitations of existing VLA reasoning: the lack of explicit anticipation of future scene dynamics and the high inference cost of repeated reasoning rollouts. By reasoning over future dynamics in latent visual space, IG-VLA provides task-relevant spatiotemporal guidance for action generation, while Scene Gist Memory further converts the acquired reasoning knowledge into compact behavioral guidance for efficient inference. Experiments across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench consistently demonstrate improved manipulation performance and generalization, with particularly strong gains under challenging language and semantic variations. Meanwhile, the gist policy retains competitive reasoning performance while substantially reducing inference cost, showing that explicit future reasoning need not be repeatedly executed at deployment. Real-world robotic experiments further validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework beyond simulation. Overall, our results suggest that anticipating future scene dynamics and subsequently internalizing such reasoning provides an effective direction toward more capable and efficient VLA policies.
paragraphs.zh: 在本项工作中，我们提出了 IG-VLA，旨在解决现有 VLA 推理的两个关键局限性：缺乏对未来场景动态的明确预测，以及重复推理展开所带来的高昂推理成本。 通过在潜在视觉空间中推理未来动态，IG-VLA 为动作生成提供了与任务相关的时空引导，而场景要点记忆则进一步将获得的推理知识转化为紧凑的行为指导，以实现高效推理。 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 VLABench 上的实验一致表明，该方法提升了操控性能和泛化能力，尤其在具有挑战性的语言和语义变化条件下表现尤为显著。 与此同时，要点策略在保持具有竞争力的推理性能的同时，大幅降低了推理成本，这表明部署时无需重复执行明确的未来推理过程。 真实世界的机器人实验进一步验证了所提出框架在模拟环境之外的有效性。 总体而言，我们的结果表明，预测未来场景动态并随后内化此类推理，为构建能力更强、效率更高的 VLA 策略提供了一条有效路径。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 summarizes the overall training and inference pipeline of IG-VLA. During training, we first encode the current and future observations into the latent visual space and construct their latent transitions as supervision. The Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning module learns to predict these future transitions from the current multimodal context, enabling the reasoning policy to anticipate task-relevant scene evolution and use the resulting future information for action prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 总结了 IG-VLA 的整体训练和推理流程。 在训练阶段，我们首先将当前和未来的观测编码到潜在视觉空间中，并构建它们的潜在转换作为监督信号。 潜在时空推理模块学习从当前的多模态上下文中预测这些未来转换，使推理策略能够预判与任务相关的场景演变，并利用由此获得的未来信息进行动作预测。

sents.en: The Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning module learns to predict these future transitions from the current multimodal context, enabling the reasoning policy to anticipate task-relevant scene evolution and use the resulting future information for action prediction.
sents.zh: 潜在时空推理模块学习从当前的多模态上下文中预测这些未来转换，使推理策略能够预判与任务相关的场景演变，并利用由此获得的未来信息进行动作预测。

paragraphs.en: We then internalize the acquired future reasoning into Scene Gist Memory. Specifically, the reasoning-enhanced representation is compressed into a compact Scene Gist target, whose associated actions are aligned with those produced by the reasoning policy. A lightweight gist encoder subsequently learns to predict this reasoning-derived Scene Gist directly from the current multimodal context, with both representation- and action-level supervision. In this way, the Scene Gist captures the behavioral knowledge distilled from explicit future reasoning without requiring the future rollout itself.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，我们将习得的未来推理内化到场景要点记忆中。 具体而言，经过推理增强的表示会被压缩为一个紧凑的场景要点目标，其关联动作与推理策略所产生的动作保持一致。 接着，一个轻量级的要点编码器将学习直接从当前的多模态上下文中预测这种源自推理的场景要点，同时接受表示层和动作层的监督。 通过这种方式，场景要点能够捕捉从显式未来推理中提炼出的行为知识，而无需实际执行未来的展开过程。

paragraphs.en: Setup. To evaluate our method beyond simulation and on an embodiment different from the training platform, we deploy the fine-tuned policy on a dual-arm UR3 setup (Figure 7 ). The hardware consists of two 6-DoF UR3 arms with parallel-jaw grippers, yielding a 14-dimensional state/action space, and observations from three RGB cameras (one top-down scene camera and two wrist cameras), each resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 before the SigLIP encoder. We consider a pick-and-place-a-screwdriver task: starting from the robot home pose, the right arm grasps a screwdriver and places it at a target location (a single-arm task; the left gripper is disabled during deployment). All policies are fine-tuned from pi05_base on 77 teleoperated demonstrations (15 Hz).
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 为了在模拟之外，并在一个不同于训练平台的实体上评估我们的方法，我们将微调后的策略部署到双臂 UR3 系统（图 7）。 该硬件由两个带有平行夹爪的 6-DoF UR3 机械臂组成，从而形成 14 维的状态/动作空间，以及来自三台 RGB 摄像机的观察数据（一台俯视场景摄像机和两台手腕摄像机），这些数据在进入 SigLIP 编码器前均被调整为 224 × 224 224\times 224 的尺寸。 我们考虑一个“抓取并放置螺丝刀”的任务：从机器人的初始姿态开始，右臂抓取一个螺丝刀并将其放置在目标位置（这是一个单臂任务；部署期间左臂夹爪被禁用）。 所有策略均基于 pi05_base，在 77 次远程操作演示（15 Hz）上进行微调。

paragraphs.en: Deployment. Since the UR3 is joint-controlled while the policy predicts actions in a delta end-effector (delta-EEF) space, we integrate each predicted delta-EEF chunk onto the current end-effector pose (obtained by forward kinematics from the measured joints) and map it back to joint targets with a numerical damped-least-squares inverse-kinematics solver (warm-started from the current joints); the robot then executes the resulting joint chunk under real-time joint-position control. This conversion is performed entirely server-side, so the joint-space robot client is unchanged. Actions are executed with a near-synchronous chunking scheme: each 10-step delta-EEF chunk is executed in full at 5 Hz before the next inference, with a joint-velocity cap of 2.5 2.5 rad/s.
paragraphs.zh: 部署。 由于 UR3 是关节控制的，而策略是在增量末端执行器（delta-EEF）空间中预测动作的，因此我们将每个预测的 delta-EEF 片段叠加到当前的末端执行器位姿上（该位姿通过基于测量关节的前向运动学计算得出），然后使用数值阻尼最小二乘逆运动学求解器将其映射回关节目标（以当前关节状态作为暖启动）；随后，机器人会在实时关节位置控制下执行由此产生的关节片段。 这种转换完全在服务器端执行，因此关节空间机器人客户端保持不变。 动作采用近乎同步的片段化方案执行：每个包含 10 步的 delta-EEF 片段都会在下次推理前以 5 Hz 的频率完整执行，同时关节速度上限为 2.5 rad/s。

paragraphs.en: Comparison and protocol. Under identical deployment conditions we compare three policies: π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , ACoT-VLA (the prior baseline), and our method (with latent spatiotemporal reasoning internalized through Scene Gist Memory).
